system.one_liner: Measures how many LoRA parameters a reasoning strategy needs to reach a fixed training accuracy and shows this intrinsic dimension tracks generalization.

content.variant_note: four tinted panels tell question, finetune-and-evaluate pipeline, intrinsic-dimension measurement and finding, each closed by a sketched sentence banner
content.argues: Reasoning strategies that need fewer trainable parameters to reach a common training accuracy (lower intrinsic dimension) generalize better, in and out of distribution.
content.subject: One word problem in three reasoning formats, a finetune-and-evaluate row, a LoRA sweep curve and an accuracy-versus-dimension scatter.

evidence: sweep varying LoRA parameter counts d and identify the minimum dint at which training accuracy crosses a common threshold
We find a strong inverse correlation between intrinsic dimensionality and generalization performance (Section 4).
we use a common threshold τ across all strategies to ensure fair comparison

summary: The paper proposes intrinsic dimensionality, the smallest number of LoRA parameters needed to reach a fixed training accuracy, as a quantitative measure of how effective a reasoning strategy is. Figure 1 is an overview in four tinted panels. A grey panel shows one GSM8K-style question answered in three formats (No CoT, Short CoT, Exec PoT) and asks which strategy generalizes best. A yellow band shows the three training sets as offset card stacks feeding a finetuned model whose accuracies (7.18%, 32.63%, 46.15%) are read on in-domain and OOD benchmark chips. A green panel plots training accuracy against LoRA parameters with a threshold tau = 63% and d_int of about 1.5M for Exec PoT. A blue panel scatters accuracy against d_int and states the finding. Every panel ends in a hand-sketched hatched banner.
summary_zh: 论文用内在维度（达到固定训练准确率所需的最少 LoRA 参数量）衡量推理链的有效性。图 1 用四个着色面板依次展示同一道题的三种推理策略、微调与评测流程、含阈值 τ 的参数扫描曲线和准确率—内在维度散点，各面板底部有手绘风格的结论横幅。
notes: The pre-screen said pictures=0; the two plots are bitmaps and are listed as pictures. The three strategy hues drift between panels (orange cards, red scatter point). The Exec PoT accuracy is printed as 46.15% in the figure. Whether the grey dots in the scatter are further strategies or model sizes is not stated in the figure or the supplied text.
